summary: Checker service: instead of every check in a cron tick starting at the exact same instant, each monitor's check now starts at a fixed per-monitor delay of 0-2s after its scheduled time (to stop DNS/TLS slowdowns from bursts); configurable with a new PUBSUB_SPREAD setting, 0 disables it.

statements.why: No logins, data, money or secrets involved; only check start timing in apps/checker/pkg/queue/consumer.go.
